product_banner: Physical / land-cover suitability proxy (open-cleared class 8 ± 4/5 + elevation demote). GO = worth a field look. CAUTION paints tidal, converted (class 5), and elevation-fail. Tenure/VERRA via flags and overlays. Not MoE zoning, tenure clearance, planting permission, or a carbon outcome. Non-commercial / research use.
notes: Classes included: [4, 5, 8] (class 7 ponds excluded — FLAG). MMU 0.5 ha.
Vectorised from inputs/screen-layers/L_class_10m/class_step3.tif with MMU 0.5 ha (50 px).
Clipped to L20 coastal four provinces (Cambodia only).
Cases A and C only (class 8 / 4). Case B omitted (class 2 / pond-shaped).
Elevation hold-back: L13 elevation_check_flag_10m joined; 1007 patches elevation_fail=true (GO demoted to CAUTION paint). Converted: class 5 open limb only.
Phase 2 flags: permit_gate from WDPA+Ramsar overlays; project_overlap from staged VCS 1748/5071/5584; stop_legal unavailable. Overlays redistributable=false where marked.
path_policy: Ship only under delivery/open-cleared/. Do not copy FLAG rasters or inputs/screen-layers binaries into this tree or a public remote.
